rows.corpus_definition: To have enough money to buy something.
rows.example_en: I cannot afford that expensive car.

rows.corpus_definition: quick to notice danger; a warning of possible danger
rows.example_en: The guard stayed alert throughout the whole night.

rows.corpus_definition: a narrow street or path between or behind buildings
rows.example_en: They walked through a dark alley to reach the market.

rows.corpus_definition: Next to or together with someone or something.
rows.example_en: He worked alongside his father for years.

rows.corpus_definition: to make a change to something so it is different
rows.example_en: We need to alter the plan slightly.

rows.corpus_definition: a senior official sent by a country to represent it abroad
rows.example_en: The ambassador met the president yesterday.

rows.corpus_definition: Something that makes you smile or laugh.
rows.example_en: We watched an amusing film last night.

rows.corpus_definition: something that is from a very long time ago
rows.example_en: We visited ancient ruins during our summer holiday.

rows.corpus_definition: A public statement about something important to everyone.
rows.example_en: The school made an important announcement today.

rows.corpus_definition: To make someone feel a little angry or impatient.
rows.example_en: Please stop tapping your pen, it annoys me.
